caption: This drawing, done in pencil on paper, depicts a large tankard with a hinged lid and an ornate handle, positioned centrally on the page. The tankard is cylindrical with smoothly curved sides, a slightly protruding circular base, and a domed lid featuring a small round finial and a thumb lever. The metalwork is rendered with shading to illustrate its reflective surface. Attached to the right side is a broad, curving handle, with an added decorative thumb rest near its base. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset square showing a standing bird with long legs and a curved neck. In the lower right corner, another inset square contains a detailed, round emblem-like design with elaborate scrollwork and intertwined letters at its center, encircled by an ornate border. The entire composition appears in grayscale pencil on an aged, yellow-tinted background. The artist's signature, "Hester Duany," is written at the bottom left corner of the central rectangle.
title: Silver Tankard
